name: Suryaamba Spinning Mills Limited
about: Suryaamba Spinning Mills Limited manufactures and sells specialty synthetic spun yarns in India. The company offers polyester, viscose, and fancy yarns, as well as other blends, such as flex, cotton citra, cotton/flax, melange, slub, recycled, and bamboo yarns. Its products are used in weaving, knitting, apparel, and other textile applications. The company exports its products to Canada, the United States, Mexico, Columbia, Peru, Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Morocco, Egypt, Nigeria, South Africa, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Turkey, Italy, Germany, Switzerland, Belgium, Poland, Argentina, and Chile. Suryaamba Spinning Mills Limited was founded in 1993 and is based in Nagpur, India.
